said: The ECB Data Portal's real responses, recorded by meridian-ecb's authors, the body gzipped: every euro foreign exchange reference rate from 3 August to 19 October 2026 (recorded 2026-10-19), and every euro short-term rate (€STR) series -- the rate with its volume, transactions, banks and percentiles, its compounded averages and its compounded index -- from 3 August to 22 October 2026 (recorded 2026-10-23), and the euro area's AAA and all-ratings government bond yield curves -- spot rates and par yields at 3, 6 and 9 months and every whole year to 30 -- from 3 August to 17 November 2026 (recorded 2026-11-19), as SDMX-CSV. The ECB allows free use of the information on its website provided it is reproduced accurately and the ECB is cited as the source (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/home/disclaimer/html/index.en.html). Sample data answers each request for a range of days from them, and the tests read them.
